# taniarae-site (production)

This repo is the **live website** at https://[DOMAIN]/.

**Do not edit files here.** All changes are made in the staging repo
(`taniarae-site-staging`), reviewed on the staging URL, and then copied here by
the **Publish to production** workflow (Actions tab › Publish to production ›
Run workflow). Anything edited directly here is overwritten on the next publish.

See `AGENTS.md` and `EDITING-GUIDE.md` in the staging repo.
